# Re-Open

> We've accepted dysfunction as destiny. We've mistaken learned helplessness for wisdom. It doesn't have to be this way.

## What Re-Open Is

Re-Open is a civic engagement platform and manifesto for renewing American society. It challenges the learned helplessness that has caused Americans to accept broken systems in healthcare, housing, education, and governance as inevitable.

The premise: the problems aren't unsolvable — they're political. Other democracies have solved them. We can too.

## Core Message

Americans have been conditioned to see systemic dysfunction as natural law. Healthcare costs that bankrupt families. Housing that a teacher or firefighter can't afford. Schools that vary wildly based on zip code. A governing class more responsive to donors than constituents.

Re-Open argues these are policy choices, not destiny — and that collective action, informed by clear thinking, can change them.

## Site

Single-page Next.js 15 site at https://re-open.us. Includes:
- A waving American flag canvas animation
- Five sections: Hero, The Problem, Where We've Given Up, The Conviction, Join
- Email signup for updates
